# HabitForge

> HabitForge is a habit tracker that turns your consistency into a rope you can see — a thin thread when a habit is new, an unbreakable cable once you have shown up day after day, and a fraying line when you slip. It runs as a web app and as an Android app on Google Play. There is no iOS app and no browser extension. Sign-in is Google-only. There is a free tier plus two paid plans, Pro and Family; the app currently ships the free tier and the paid plans are not yet available for purchase — see /pricing.md.

This file follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) format and gives AI agents an at-a-glance overview of the documentation.

## What HabitForge does

- Habit tracking with the cue → routine → reward loop (plus craving and investment) from *The Power of Habit*
- Daily check-ins that build streaks and points
- A rope visualization (D3) showing each habit's strength from streak, consistency, and total check-ins — a deterministic calculation, not a machine-learning model
- A ten-tier forge level (Spark → Forge Master) driven by points
- Weekly analytics and charts
- Achievements with a celebration moment and bonus points
- An optional, opt-in community: feed, comments, challenges, friends, and a leaderboard, with report and block moderation
- Light and dark themes plus a full theme customizer
- Offline support as a Progressive Web App; check-ins made offline sync on reconnect
- Automatic in-app updates on the Android app

## What it doesn't do

- No iOS app (there is no Apple Developer account); iPhone/iPad users run the web app
- No browser extension
- No public REST or GraphQL API and no programmatic integrations
- No email/password or Apple sign-in — Google sign-in only
- It does not provide health-care advice
